proved_scope: All odd primes and all Witt lengths admit the explicit compatible radial tower. Its algebraic restricted limit has coordinate functions not both rational; its polynomial reduction degrees are unbounded. Exact finite checks cover p=2,3,5,7 and radial p=3 moduli 9,27,81.
scope_exclusions: No universal impossibility for all lifts of the residue map
